pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions exhibit a stellate geometry with jagged, irregular margins and sharp pixel gradients. Individual patches are larger on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored pathways form a dense, interconnected grid with frequent junction nodes. The pathways maintain a relatively thin and consistent pixel width throughout the observed region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane on the upper neck presents a jagged 1D profile with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations visible against the background.
